newsitem.title: UK: Britain says it evacuates 131 from Albania.
newsitem.headline: Britain says it evacuates 131 from Albania.

text.p: The British foreign office said it had evacuated 131 people successfully from Albania on Friday morning and they were now on their way to the Italian Adriatic Sea port of Brindisi.

A foreign office spokesman said the 131, including 65 Britons, three Irish citizens, 11 Commonwealth citizens and 52 others, had been safely taken off the beach in the port of Durres about 30 km (20 miles) west of Tirana.
The group was aboard an Italian naval vessel, he said.
At least 10 more Britons spent Thursday night at the British embassy in the Albanian capital.

Diplomats were waiting to see how many more responded to an appeal broadcast on BBC World Service radio for British citizens to present themselves at the embassy before arranging another evacuation effort, the spokesman said.
No decision had been made on the evacuation route.
Albanian authorities, buoyed by a new all-party government, have appealed unsuccessfully for calm against a campaign by rebels demanding the resignation of President Sali Berisha.

But as the country drifted towards anarchy, tanks appeared on the streets of Tirana late on Thursday and residents braced for a rampage by mobs brandishing weapons stolen from army depots -- the scenes in other Albanian towns and cities.
